---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new transform, option, or capability
title: ''
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem statement

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard or impossible today? If this
is about token savings, say roughly how much you expect to gain and on what
kind of code.

## Language backend

Which backend does this concern?

- [ ] python
- [ ] rust
- [ ] other / cross-cutting (please describe — e.g. tokenizers, CLI, a new
      language)

## Proposed solution

What should TokenPress do? For a new transform, please note whether it is
context-lossless or a trade-off that would need an opt-in flag, and whether it
can be checked by the existing verification (re-parse + equivalence).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you looked at, including doing it outside TokenPress, and why
they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, prior art in other formatters/minifiers, sample code.
